trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version with a healthy record in production. Health checks now pass and the error rate has returned to normal (~0.2%).
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks - rolled back to v2.3.0," describing the failure, the rollback, and the recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 is now flagged unhealthy and should not be redeployed until the root cause is investigated and change-manager approval is obtained.
